statement.notes: The statement does not have a single line item exactly named 'Depreciation and amortization'. However, there are two relevant items: 'Depreciation and impairment of Equipment on operating leases, net' and 'Depreciation, amortization and impairment charges on Property, net'. These two line items were summed to approximate total depreciation and amortization. This sum includes impairment charges, which are non-cash expenses typically included in the depreciation/amortization adjustment on a cash flow statement.
